column3: CA FAIR Plan will exceed 750K policies by end of 2026 as 2026 wildfire season reinforces carrier retreat and Sustainable Insurance Strategy proves insufficient to attract major private capacity
column9: 6+ major carriers publicly commit to CA with actual volume AND FAIR Plan begins sustained decline
column10: LOWERED 72%->55% (2026-08-10, Q2 primary: cfpnet.com). Jun 2026: 696,562 policies (+8% since Sept 2025), $768B exposure. Quarterly net-add pace is DECELERATING for 2 consecutive quarters: Sept->Dec +18K(6.0K/mo) -> Dec->Mar +16.4K(5.5K/mo) -> Mar->Jun +12.2K(4.1K/mo). Linear extrapolation lands ~705-716K by Dec-2026, BELOW 750K. This reverses the 04-17 raise, which was based on an accelerating-pace read that has since inverted. Wildfire season (May-Oct) not yet reflected in Jun data — a major-fire event (as in Jan-2025) could still spike enrollment; confidence reflects that tail upside, not certainty of a miss. CA DOI approved ~30% rate hike (vs 35.8% requested) eff Oct-15-2026 — first wildfire-catastrophe-model-based ruling, may slow OR accelerate FAIR Plan growth depending on whether it repels or attracts private capacity. ML-POLLY-23.
